subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw add native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and if so which defaults and protected paths should be part of the core CLI contract?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but default filters, ignore-file behavior, and protected recovery paths decide the balance between backup size, sensitive-file avoidance, and restorable archives.

options.title: Review the linked native-exclude PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle flags, defaults, protected paths, manifest behavior, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Ship explicit excludes first
options.body: Add only `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` now, deferring smart defaults until restore safety and large-install proof are clearer.

options.title: Decline core excludes
options.body: Keep core backup scope coarse and document plugin or ClawHub alternatives only if maintainers decide native exclusion is outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Review the linked native-exclude PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle flags, defaults, protected paths, manifest behavior, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the original backup CLI contract as reviewer/co-author and adjacent backup helper contributor.
